title: Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations: Schedule of Payer Coverage by Tier
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations** are tiered by two facts about a leave: the payer source of the stay during which the leave occurs (Medical Assistance, private pay or Medicare Part A) and the kind of leave (a hospital leave, meaning an inpatient or observation stay at a hospital, or a therapeutic leave, meaning a home or community visit under the care plan). The Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed is entered only where a physician order for the leave is also in place.

## Coverage schedule

| Tier | Payer source | Leave | Reserved days the Pennsylvania Medical Assistance program pays per hospitalization | Therapeutic leave days the program pays per calendar year | Payer days held without a written election unless declined | Every held day is the resident's own charge | Physician order for the leave on the care plan before days are reserved |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed | Medical Assistance | hospital | 15 | 0 | Yes | No | No |
| Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed | Medical Assistance | therapeutic | 0 | 30 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | private pay | hospital | 0 | 0 | No | Yes | No |
| Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | private pay | therapeutic | 0 | 0 | No | Yes | No |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | Medicare Part A | hospital | 0 | 0 | No | Yes | No |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | Medicare Part A | therapeutic | 0 | 0 | No | Yes | No |

The day counts are those stated in the center's Medicaid bed-hold notice; a 0 means the payer pays no reserved days of that kind on that tier.

| Tier | Held days billable to Medicare Part A | Reserved days the payer pays are ever billed to the resident | Medical Assistance patient pay unchanged for a month with reserved days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed | No | No | Yes |
| Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed | No | No | Yes |
| Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | No | No | No |
| Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | No | No | No |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | No | No | No |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | No | No | No |

Leave days are never Part A days, so no tier bills a held day to Medicare Part A.

## Terms common to every tier

- **What one hospitalization is.** For the per-hospitalization count, one hospitalization is the continuous absence from the transfer to the return.
- **Year for therapeutic days.** Therapeutic leave days are counted over the calendar year.
- **Purposes of therapeutic leave.** Therapeutic leave is granted for a home visit, a family event or a community placement trial visit.

## Reading the schedule

*Which tier does a leave fall on?* The tier is read from the stay's payer source and the kind of leave together: a Medical Assistance resident admitted to a hospital is on the Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed; a privately paying resident on a home visit is on the Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold.

*Does a 0 in a payer-day column mean the tier has no hold?* No. It means only that the payer pays no reserved days of that kind; on the tiers where every held day is the resident's own charge, the bed may still be held at the resident's expense.
